correctness.rationale: Explicit four-state Markov generator has strictly positive cofactor stationary weights. Algebra reduces expected occupied patches and joint occupancy to common positive-denominator quadratic ratios. Strict derivative monotonicity, positivity and root evaluation establish unique optimizers, both exact sharp budget thresholds, their ordering, and all equality cases. Reconstructed exact stationary linear systems agree in 405 rational tests; finite tests are supporting only.

value.rationale: This is a structural resource-allocation difference between two natural ecological objectives. The exact sharp budget interval in which expected occupancy benefits from splitting colonization resources while maximizing both-patch occupancy still favors an all-to-the-weaker-patch allocation identifies a qualitative conflict, not merely a sample calculation. The direction-ordering is uniform for every positive parameter tuple with unequal extinction rates.
